chapter: The Original Dixieland band to California
title: Leaving Tody Harris's band with the saxophone parts
summary: Joe left his Baton Rouge job at once, but forgot to give back the alto parts, which the bandleader chased him down for at the train.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: That was the only two guys... I remember this guy approached me that day and asked me when could I leave. I said, "I can leave any time. I ain't got nothin' to do here in Baton Rouge." But I had to play with Toby Mitchell. [LAUGHS] I have to laugh about this. In my saxophone case, I had a... We played orchestrations.
You were still playing saxophone. You still hadn't gone back to the clarinet.

That's right. We had played a dance that night, and I took some of the saxophone parts at home to kind of practice off of. Toby [sic: TODY HARRIS] said, "Brush up on them a little bit; you're kind of rusty" or whatever. And I got my clothes together right away, and got on the train, and Toby...I mean....
You said Toby Mitchell, and I know you meant... It slipped my mind now. The three bands you were talking about, Toots Johnson and the number-two band... It won't come back to me now, doggone it.
What's this guy's name? I have a blackout.
Yeah, me too. We were talking about him earlier, but now I can't think of him. [TODY HARRIS]
But Toby Mitchell was the band that you left to go with.

Yes. And I had this music... Anyway, this guy, somebody told him, "Hey, your saxophone player's leaving you, man. Who gonna play saxophone in your band?" And the guy says, "What do you mean?" He said, "I seen him down on the way to the railroad station with some guy, and I think he's going to Houston, Texas, to play." Next thing I know, this guy is on the train and said, "Hey, you can go, but where's my music?" -- for these alto parts. And I said, "Well, I forgot about them." He said, "You put them in your case last night." So sure enough, there they was.
